summary: Drop implementation has three data-integrity and design-evidence conformance defects.

findings.summary: Failed drop discards local changes in the run folder.
findings.evidence: The CLI contract requires git failures to restore the folder and leave nothing changed. When git rm rejects a modified tracked file, rollback checks out the folder from HEAD and removes the archive. Reset also discards staged changes under the folder.
findings.fix: Preserve and restore the original index and working-tree contents on failure, or refuse dirty affected paths before copying or modifying anything.

findings.summary: Archive silently omits every nested file named lock.json.
findings.evidence: FR-003 and FR-005 exclude the run's transient lock.json but require the whole remaining folder to be copied and verified. ignore_patterns and dircmp ignore lock.json at every depth.
findings.fix: Exclude only the transient lock beside state.json and verify all other files, including nested lock.json files.

findings.summary: Ignored Pen evidence is omitted from the drop commit.
findings.evidence: FR-017 requires factory/design/ to land at docs/design/<branch>/ with identical content in the drop commit. git add respects ignore rules, so an ignored capture remains only in the local worktree and is absent from HEAD.
findings.fix: Ensure every design evidence file is included in the permanent committed target, including ignored files, or refuse before changes when that cannot be guaranteed.
